---Service Parameter : 0USER_ID
---Service Parameter : 1MENU_ID
---Check client parameter : USER_ID
---FOUND USER_ID
-- TYPE = nvarchar---Add string Service
---Check client parameter : MENU_ID
---FOUND MENU_ID
-- TYPE = nvarchar---Add string Service

    	 WITH M_TABLE AS (
					   		SELECT SEGMENT1     AS USER_ID  			
									, SEGMENT2     AS MENU_ID  			
									, SEGMENT3     AS MEA_ID 		  	         													
									, SEGMENT4     AS MEA_NAME													
									, SEGMENT5     AS MEA_VALUE          
									, ATTRIBUTE1   AS TYPE                   
									, ATTRIBUTE2   AS FLAG               
									, ATTRIBUTE3   AS ACTIVE_FLAG       
					     	FROM   	SCM_SYS_LOOKUP_VALUE A WITH(NOLOCK)
						    WHERE  	A.LOOKUP_TYPE_CODE = 'UI_AMEND_MEASURE'
						    AND     A.SEGMENT2 = 'FP00600_Main'
						    AND 	A.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
			   )
			 SELECT * FROM (SELECT   ISNULL(A.MEA_ID, B.MEA_ID) MEA_ID
						,ISNULL(B.MEA_NAME, A.MEA_NAME) MEA_NAME
						,ISNULL(B.MEA_VALUE, A.MEA_VALUE) MEA_VALUE
						,ISNULL(B.TYPE, A.TYPE) TYPE
						,ISNULL(B.FLAG, A.FLAG) FLAG
						,A.MENU_ID
						,'jaeuk.shin' AS USER_ID
			FROM   M_TABLE A WITH(NOLOCK)
			LEFT OUTER JOIN (
			    SELECT *
			    FROM   TH_UIS_USER_AMEND_MEA_RELATE B WITH(NOLOCK)
			    WHERE  USER_ID = 'jaeuk.shin'
			    AND    MENU_ID = 'FP00600_Main'
			    AND    ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y'
			) B
			ON    A.MENU_ID = B.MENU_ID
			AND   A.MEA_ID  = B.MEA_ID
			AND   A.TYPE 	= B.TYPE
			WHERE 1=1
			AND   A.ACTIVE_FLAG = 'Y') B
GROUP BY MEA_ID, MEA_NAME, MEA_VALUE, TYPE, FLAG, MENU_ID, USER_ID

SELECT B.SETUP_COLOR_CODE, A.* FROM FP_AMEND_MEMO_M  A WITH(NOLOCK)
inner JOIN FP_AMEND_SETUP_COLOR_M B WITH(NOLOCK)
ON A.INSTANCE_ID = B.INSTANCE_ID
AND A.COMPANY_ID = B.COMPANY_ID
AND A.DIVISION_ID = B.DIVISION_ID
AND A.SITE_ID = B.SITE_ID
AND A.FACTORY_ID = B.FACTORY_ID
AND A.OPERATION_ID = B.OPERATION_ID
AND A.LINE_ID = B.LINE_ID
AND A.ELECTRODE_TYPE = B.ELECTRODE_TYPE
AND A.EQUIPMENT_ID = B.EQUIPMENT_ID
AND A.MARKET = B.MARKET
AND A.ITEM_ID = B.ITEM_ID
AND A.TOP_ITEM_ID = B.TOP_ITEM_ID
AND A.PRODUCTION_TYPE = B.PRODUCTION_TYPE
AND A.PLAN_DATE = B.PLAN_DATE
AND ISNULL(B.SETUP_COLOR_CODE,'') <>''
WHERE ISNULL(A.INSTANCE_ID,'') = @INSTANCE_ID
